command: python -m flight_simulator mission --route lax-burbank --brain connectome --seconds 1800 --backend flightgear --telemetry-port 5501 --control-port 5502

control.label: FLY BRAIN (connectome) flying the full mission (takeoff, circuit, landing)
control.neurons_decide: pitch (jump/rotation, flare), steering and roll through descending-neuron rates (DNp01/02/04/11, DNp07, DNp15, DNa02, DNp20, MN9)
control.code_decides: synthetic runway/path and known-obstacle sensory encoding of aircraft state, the fixed decoder from DN rates to controls, the behavioural-state gate (standing/flying), a fixed-gain pitch-rate reflex (haltere stand-in), speed-dependent ground steering limits/yaw damping, stale-decision rejection, a fixed flare pitch envelope, and phase handover (flies.py); airport waypoints, MSL/runway transforms, predictive obstacle heading selection, and destination rollout braking are code rules (airport_route.py)
control.autopilot: never: the fly does not use the airplane autopilot/autothrottle; AutopilotGuard forces it off and stops the run if it cannot

fg_sessions.name: LAX 25R takeoff - CONNECTOME, LAX-Burbank route (26b50af), clear weather
